Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
network.server.socket.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements Runnable
Reader for a single socket client, run on the per-player client-<name> thread. It blocks reading ClientCommands and dispatches each to its destination: lobby commands to the LobbyManager, in-game commands to the player's game-session queue, and heartbeats to the liveness watchdog. When the stream ends or fails it triggers the disconnect pipeline via LobbyManager.onDisconnect(String).
